title: autumn negroni
content: 2 oz Dry Gin (Beefeater) 3/4 oz Carpano Antica Sweet Vermouth (Alessio) 1/2 oz Cynar 1/2 oz Campari 1/4 oz Fernet Branca 1 dash Orange Bitters (Regan's) 1 dash Peychaud's Bitters Stir with ice, strain into a coupe glass, and garnish with an orange twist.

title: Cloud Forest
content: Cloud Forest glassware Goblet or double rocks glass ingredients 1.5 oz vodka (100 proof) 1.5 oz coconut mix .5 oz lime juice 4 drops saline 15 18 thai basil leaves 1/4 tsp xantham gum 170 grams crushed ice garnish Sprig of Thai basil equipment Jigger High speed blender instructions 1. Add all ingredients except xantham gum and ice to blender. 1. Dry blend (without ice) until fully combined and slowly add xantham gum. 1. Add ice while continuing to blend recommended brands Vodka: Smirnoff 100 proof Coconut mix: 50/50 Coco Lopez and 1:1 simple syrup notes Fresh lime juice is strongly recommended. Thai basil can be found at most Asian markets. Regular basil is not a substitute. tags rum, tiki, herbal

title: Quarantine Order
tags: rum tiki sour tropical citrus passion-fruit rum
content: Quarantine Order glassware 16 oz mason jar ingredients 3 oz rum 1 oz lime juice, strained 1 oz grapefruit juice, strained .5 oz passion fruit syrup .5 oz cinnamon syrup 5 dashes Angostura Bitters equipment Jigger Mixing tin Flash blender instructions 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing tin. 1. Fill with 8 oz crushed ice and flash blend 5 10 seconds. 1. Pour into glass, add crushed ice to fill. 1. Garnish and serve. recommended brands Rum: 50/50 of Appleton Signature and Hamilton Jamaican Pot Still Gold Passion fruit syrup: Liber & Co. Cinnamon syrup: Liber & Co. notes Fresh juice is strongly recommended. Crushed ice provides the most authentic tiki presentation and dilution. tags rum, tiki, sour, tropical, citrus, passion fruit, rum

title: Tropical Thunder (Hurricane Variant)
tags: rum tiki sour tropical citrus passion-fruit overproof-rum shaken OFTD
content: Tropical Thunder (Hurricane Variant) summary A rich, full strength Hurricane built from the Minimalist Tiki recipe. Bright lemon and passion fruit provide tart tropical flavors, while vanilla syrup and allspice dram add warmth and baking spice notes. Plantation O.F.T.D. delivers a bold, overproof rum backbone with deep molasses and funky Jamaican character. glassware 16 oz mason jar or Hurricane glass (if using the latter, will need to double the recipe) ingredients 2 oz overproof rum 1 oz lemon juice scant .75 oz passion fruit syrup .375 oz vanilla syrup .375 oz allspice dram garnish Lemon wheel Edible flower (optional) Mint sprig (optional) equipment Jigger Mixing tin Flash blender instructions 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing tin. 1. Fill with 8 oz crushed ice and flash blend 5 10 seconds. 1. Pour into glass, add crushed ice to fill. 1. Garnish and serve. recommended brands Rum: Plantation O.F.T.D. Passion fruit syrup: Liber & Co. Vanilla syrup: Portland Syrups Allspice dram: St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram notes Fresh lemon juice is strongly recommended. For a slightly less intense drink, split the rum base with 2 oz O.F.T.D. and 2 oz aged Jamaican or Demerara rum. Crushed ice provides the most authentic tiki presentation and dilution. tags rum, tiki, sour, tropical, citrus, passion fruit, overproof rum, shaken, OFTD
